## sarifix diff

Print new, fixed and unchanged findings by fingerprint

### Synopsis

Compare a base and a head SARIF set by fingerprint. Line numbers never count,
so findings that only moved are unchanged.

Fingerprints come from primaryLocationLineHash when the tool provides it,
then other partialFingerprints, then a hash of the flagged lines. The lines
come from the SARIF snippet; else the sarifix/v1 fingerprint that 'sarifix
scan' recorded is used; else they are read from the files: under --repo for
head and --base-root for base (default --repo).

```
sarifix diff [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  sarifix diff --base main.sarif --head pr.sarif
  sarifix diff --base 'base/*.sarif' --head 'sarif/*.sarif' --json
```

### Options

```
      --base strings       base SARIF files or globs (required)
      --base-root string   checkout of the base commit, for reading snippets (default --repo)
      --head strings       head SARIF files or globs (required)
  -h, --help               help for diff
      --unchanged          also list unchanged findings
```
